definition-dropped.flag: character | in a coded character set (newer: undefined); character | in a screen item (newer: undefined); character | in cobol character repertoire (newer: undefined); character | in computer storage (newer: undefined)
definition-dropped.answer: 2002 defines 'character' in four senses (§2002:4, 4.26 to 4.29: coded value, graphic character in a screen item, COBOL character, code value in storage) and 'coded character set' (4.40); 2023's clause 3 defines none of them and uses the words in their ordinary sense. In GR4, 'the last character of the input field' is a character in a screen item (4.27 'A graphic character'). The screen section is processor-dependent in 2002 (§2002:3.1.5 with B.3), and the compiler refuses it at --std 2002 with COBOL1560 (the reader's probe), so the evidence is unaffected. The term picks out the same characters in both, so the scope and the evidence do not change.
